{{Current events|year=2020|month=04|day=10|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Business and economy
*[[Socio-economic impact of the 2019–20 coronavirus pandemic]]; [[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Europe]]
**[[Economic and Financial Affairs Council|EU finance ministers]] agree on a [[Euro|€]]540 billion loan package to alleviate the economic fallout of the coronavirus pandemic. [https://www.nytimes.com/2020/04/09/world/coronavirus-news-international.html (''The New York Times'')]

;Health and environment
*[[2019–20 coronavirus pandemic]]
**The first [[United Nations Security Council]] meeting on the pandemic is held in a closed video-conference session. [http://www.newsonair.com/Main-News-Details.aspx?id=385197 (AIR)]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Asia]]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Yemen]]
****[[Yemen]] reports its first confirmed case of [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]], a patient in the [[Hadhramaut Governorate]]. [https://gulfnews.com/world/gulf/yemen/covid-19-yemen-reports-first-coronavirus-case-1.1586494636554 (Gulf News)]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Iran]]
****[[Iran]]'s [[Ministry of Health and Medical Education]] reports 1,972 new confirmed cases and 122 more deaths from COVID-19, bringing the country's death toll to 4,232 and 68,192 total cases, while 3,969 people remain in critical condition with the virus. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-iran/irans-death-toll-from-coronavirus-outbreak-rises-to-4232-idUSKCN21S11J?il=0 (Reuters)]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Europe]]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Germany]]
****The [[Robert Koch Institute]] reports 5,323 new confirmed cases and 266 more deaths from COVID-19, bringing [[Germany]]'s death toll to 2,373 with 113,525 total cases. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-germany-infections/germanys-coronavirus-cases-rise-by-5323-deaths-by-266-rki-idUSKCN21S0CY (Reuters)]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****The [[Department of Health and Social Care]] reports 980 more deaths from COVID-19, the highest daily death toll in the country to date, bringing the [[United Kingdom|UK]]'s death toll to 8,958. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/apr/10/coronavirus-uk-deadliest-day-deaths-announced (''The Guardian'')]
****[[NHS England]] announces two more temporary [[NHS Nightingale Hospitals]] to treat COVID-19 patients in [[Washington, Tyne and Wear|Washington]], and [[Exeter]]. [https://www.england.nhs.uk/2020/04/nhs-steps-up-coronavirus-fight-with-two-more-nightingale-hospitals/ (NHS England)]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Belgium]]
****[[Belgium]] reports 1,684 new confirmed cases and 494 more deaths from COVID-19, its highest daily death toll to date, bringing the country's death toll to 3,019 and 26,667 total cases. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/europe/coronavirus-death-toll-exceeds-3-000-in-belgium/1799939 (Anadolu Agency)]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in the Republic of Ireland]]
****The [[Republic of Ireland]]'s [[Taoiseach]] [[Leo Varadkar]] extends stay-at-home coronavirus restrictions until May 5. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-health-coronavirus-ireland/ireland-extends-coronavirus-lockdown-to-may-5-idUKKCN21S1P3 (Reuters)]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in North America]]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in the United States]]
****[[Johns Hopkins University]] records 2,108 more deaths from COVID-19 in the [[United States]], the highest daily death toll in the country to date, bringing the U.S. death toll to 18,693 and 500,399 confirmed cases. The U.S. becomes the first country to report over 2,000 COVID-19 deaths in a single day. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-52249963 (BBC)] 
***[[Impact of the 2019-20 coronavirus pandemic on education]]
****Students of Outside Creek Elementary School in California attend classes despite Governor Gavin Newsom's order to close all schools in the state. [https://www.boston.com/news/education/2020/04/10/for-students-at-a-lone-school-in-california-class-is-still-on (Boston)]
*[[Kivu Ebola epidemic]]
**In a major setback for efforts to declare the end of the outbreak on Sunday, the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]] reports the first case of [[Ebola]] since February. The outbreak has killed more than 2,200 people since August 2018. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-ebola-congo/congo-reports-first-ebola-case-in-six-weeks-idUSKCN21S1P5 (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*A [[prison riot]] breaks out at a high-security prison in [[Angarsk]], [[Irkutsk Oblast]], [[Russia]], allegedly in response to an officer beating an inmate. Large sections of the prison are set on fire, and causalities are reported. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-52251265 (BBC)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 Kiribati parliamentary election]]
**[[Kiribati]] postpones its parliamentary elections for a week. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/413994/delayed-start-for-kiribati-elections (RNZ)]

;Science and technology
*The [[European Space Agency]]/[[JAXA]] space probe [[BepiColombo]] makes its final [[gravity assist]] around [[Earth]], and is now on course for [[Venus]], where it will make several gravity assist manoeuvres before finally arriving at [[Mercury (planet)|Mercury]] in 2025. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-52229667 (BBC)]
